Container.Name: vustudio-agent
Container.Overview: Exposes this Unraid server's sensors (CPU, memory, temperatures, disks, network, array state, parity check and disk temperatures) to VU Studio, which shows them on Streacom VU1 dials. Uses host networking so network rates and mDNS discovery work. Set an access token and enter the same token in VU Studio. If you leave it empty, the agent generates one on the first start, keeps it in the data folder and prints it once in the container log.

Config.Name: Agent port
Config.Description: Port VU Studio connects to (host network: the agent listens on it directly).

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: Shared secret VU Studio sends as a Bearer token. Leave empty to have one generated on the first start: it is printed in the container log and kept in the data folder (token file).

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Keeps the generated token (file 'token'). Must be writable by uid 1654: run 'chown 1654 /mnt/user/appdata/vustudio-agent' if the log says the token could not be saved.

Config.Name: Display name
Config.Description: Name shown in VU Studio. Default: the container host name.

Config.Name: Unraid state files
Config.Description: Array state, parity check and disk temperatures. Mount the directory, not single files.

Config.Name: Unraid state path (inside the container)
Config.Description: Do not change unless you changed the container path above.

Config.Name: Array mounts
Config.Description: Lets the agent report free space of the array, cache and pools.
